examples.text: ninhāya sabbapāpakāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca sabbaloke, devamanussesu kappiyesu, kappaṃ n'eti tam'āhu nhātako'ti.
virato idha sabbapāpakehi, nirayadukkhaṃ aticca vīriyavā so, so vīriyavā padhānavā, dhīro tādi pavuccate tathattā.

58901.meaning1: in full flower; in full blossom
58901.commentary: (MNa) sabbapāliphullā'ti sabbattha pāliphullā, mūlato paṭṭhāya yāva aggā apupphitaṭṭhānaṃ nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: ramaṇīyaṃ, āvuso ānanda, gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbapāliphullā sālā, dibbā, maññe, gandhā sampavanti, kathaṃrūpena, āvuso ānanda, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti?

58902.meaning1: meal for followers of all religions

58903.commentary: (VMVt) sabbapāsehī'ti sabbakilesapāsehi. ye dibbā ye ca mānusā'ti ye dibbakāmaguṇanissitā, mānusakakāmaguṇanissitā ca kilesapāsā nāma atthi, sabbehi tehi.

examples.text: mutt'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā. tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, muttā sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā. caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

58907.meaning1: giving up everything; abandoning the whole lot

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, sabbappahānāya dhammo? cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, pahātabbaṃ, rūpā pahātabbā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ pahātabbaṃ, cakkhusamphasso pahātabbo

58908.meaning1: who has given up everything; who has abandoned all; (comm) who has given up all evil

examples.text: taṃ ve tamonudaṃ dhīraṃ, tevijjaṃ maccuhāyinaṃ, hitaṃ devamanussānaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinaṃ.
yassa rāgo ca doso ca, avijjā ca virājitā, taṃ bhāvitatt'aññataraṃ, brahmabhūtaṃ tathāgataṃ, buddhaṃ verabhay'ātītaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinan'ti.

58909.meaning1: in full flower; in full blossom
58909.commentary: (MNa) sabbapāliphullā'ti sabbattha pāliphullā, mūlato paṭṭhāya yāva aggā apupphitaṭṭhānaṃ nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: ramaṇīyaṃ, āvuso ānanda, gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbaphāliphullā sālā, dibbā, maññe, gandhā sampavanti, kathaṃrūpena, āvuso ānanda, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti?
sabbaphāliphullā kho, ānanda, yamakasālā akālapupphehi. te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.

58910.meaning1: free from all bonds; liberated from all ties

examples.text: cittasmiṃ vasībhūt'āmhi, iddhipādā subhāvitā, sabbabandhanamutta-amhi, na taṃ bhāyāmi āvuso'ti.

58911.meaning1: most foolish; most stupid of all
58911.meaning2: most foolish; most stupid of all

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, ayañ'ca imesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sabbabālo sabbamūḷho. kathañ'hi nāma sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākarissatī'ti.

58912.meaning1: all states of existence; all forms of existence

examples.text: ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
kadā nu'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu, ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ, aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

58913.meaning1: all states of existence; all forms of existence

examples.text: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.
suddhassa ve sadā phaggu, suddhass'uposatho sadā, suddhassa sucikammassa, sadā sampajjate vataṃ, idh'eva sināhi brāhmaṇa, sabbabhūtesu karohi khemataṃ.
tathāgatassa buddhassa, sabbabhūt'ānukampino, tass'accayā na vijjanti, tassa n'atthi apāgataṃ, so na sammoham'āpādi, so'va dhīro sadā sato'ti.

58915.meaning1: compassionate for all beings; sympathetic to all living beings

examples.text: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
tathāgatassa buddhassa, sabbabhūt'ānukampino, tass'accayā na vijjanti, tassa n'atthi apāgataṃ, so na sammoham'āpādi, so'va dhīro sadā sato'ti.

58916.commentary: (NIDD1) nihīnato passati sabbam'aññan'ti. aññaṃ satthāraṃ dhamm'akkhānaṃ gaṇaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittato dissati passati dakkhati oloketi nijjhāyati upaparikkhatī'ti, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.

examples.text: yadattanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tadeva so tattha samuggahāya, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.

58917.meaning1: all conception; all imagination; all make-believe; every idea; all illusion

examples.text: sabbamaññitānaṃ tv'eva, bhikkhu, samatikkamā muni santo'ti vuccati. muni kho pana, bhikkhu, santo na jāyati, na jīyati, na mīyati, na kuppati, na piheti.
sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sāruppaṃ vo, bhikkhave, paṭipadaṃ desessāmi.

58918.meaning1: suitable for eradicating all conception; supportive for exterminating all imagination

examples.text: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti. ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sappāyā paṭipadā'ti.

58919.meaning1: suitable for eradicating all conception; fit for exterminating all imagination

examples.text: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti. ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sāruppā paṭipadā'ti.

58920.commentary: (VINa) sabbamattikāmayan'ti piṭṭha-saṅghāṭaka-kavāṭa-sūcighaṭika-vātapāna-kavāṭamattaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ bhitti-chadan'iṭṭhaka-thambh'ādi-bhedaṃ sabbaṃ gehasambhāraṃ mattikāmayam'eva katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho, bho, gotama, sabbam'atthī'ti? sabbam'atthī'ti kho, brāhmaṇa, ayam'eko anto.

58922.meaning1: all churning thought; all mental disturbance

examples.text: tasmā tathāgato sabbamaññitānaṃ sabbamathitānaṃ sabba-ahaṃkāra-mamaṃkāra-mān'ānusayānaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā anupādā vimutto'ti vadāmī'ti.

58923.meaning1: all day and all night; all the time

examples.text: yassa sabbam'ahorattaṃ, ahiṃsāya rato mano, mettaṃ so sabbabhūtesu, veraṃ tassa na kenacī'ti.

58924.meaning1: throughout the day and night; continuously; all the time

examples.text: divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā, sannaddho khattiyo tapati, jhāyī tapati brāhmaṇo, atha sabbam'ahorattiṃ, buddho tapati tejasā'ti.
kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sabbamitto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.

58928.meaning1: all of this; all of these

examples.text: ahañ'c'amhi adhammiko, yo'haṃ itthiyā kāraṇā rañño ambaṃ avaharāmi. sabbam'idaṃ carimaṃ katan'ti tatth'eva paripati.

58929.meaning1: as soon as all this was said; no sooner than all this was done

examples.text: ahañ'c'amhi adhammiko, yo'haṃ itthiyā kāraṇā rañño ambaṃ avaharāmi. sabbam'idaṃ carimaṃ katan'ti tatth'eva paripati.

58930.meaning1: based on all items; rooted in all things

58931.meaning1: most deluded; most confused of all
58931.meaning2: most deluded; most confused of all

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, ayañ'ca imesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sabbabālo sabbamūḷho. kathañ'hi nāma sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākarissatī'ti.

58932.meaning1: all of this; all of these

examples.text: yañ'ca padaṃ, yañ'ca anupadaṃ, yañ'ca anvakkharaṃ, yañ'ca anubyañjanaṃ, sabbam'etaṃ padaso nāma.
sabbam'p'idaṃ hāyatu ca jīratu ca bhijjatu ca deha-nissitaṃ

58934.meaning1: all bonds; every tie; all attachments

examples.text: puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ, sappañño vat'āyaṃ upāsako, yo cīrāya adāsi cīvaraṃ, sabbayogehi vippamuttiyā'ti.

58935.meaning1: detached from all ties; free from all attachment
58935.commentary: (MNa) sabbayogavisaṃyuttan'ti sabbakilesayogavisaṃyuttaṃ. (THIa) sabbayogavisaṃyuttā'ti sabbehi kāmayog'ādīhi yogehi vimuttā tato eva anāsavā hutvā loke cara, diṭṭhasukhavihārena viharāhī'ti attho.

examples.text: hitvā mānusakaṃ yogaṃ, dibbaṃ yogaṃ upaccagā, sabbayogavisaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
diṭṭhiyogaṃ samūhacca, avijjañ'ca virājayaṃ, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, te ve yog'ātigā munī'ti.

58936.meaning1: made of all jewels; made of all gems
58936.meaning2: made of all jewels; made of all gems
58936.commentary: (DNa) sabbaratanamayo'ti ettha ekā iṭṭhakā sovaṇṇamayā, ekā rūpiyamayā, ekā veḷuriyamayā, ekā phalikamayā, ekā lohit'aṅkamayā, ekā masāragallamayā, ekā sabbaratanamayā, ayaṃ pākāro sabbapākārānaṃ anto ubbedhena saṭṭhihattho ahosi.

examples.text: sabbaratanamayassa tālassa sabbaratanamayo khandho ahosi, sabbaratanamayāni pattāni ca phalāni ca.

58937.meaning1: all night long; lasting the whole night
58937.construction:
sabba + ratti + ka + aṃ
sabbarattika + aṃ

examples.text: pañc'āhikaṃ kho pana mayaṃ, bhante, sabbarattikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdāma. evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, appamattā ātāpino pahit'attā viharāmā'ti

58938.commentary: (SNa) sabbaratticāro'ti kattikanakkhattaṃ ghosetvā sakalanagaraṃ dhajapaṭāk'ādīhi paṭimaṇḍetvā pavattito sabbaratticāro.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena vesāliyaṃ vajjiputtako sabbaratticāro hoti. atha kho so bhikkhu vesāliyā tūriya-tāḷita-vādita-nigghosasaddaṃ sutvā paridevamāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

58939.meaning1: shining the whole night; shining all through the night

examples.text: bhūmiṃ gato bhūmigato, sabbarattiṃ sobhaṇo sabbarattisobhaṇo. apāyaṃ gato apāyagato, issarena kataṃ issarakataṃ, sallena viddho sallaviddho, kathinassa dussaṃ kathinadussaṃ

58940.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sabbaratti
58940.meaning1: whole night; all through the night

examples.text: bhūmiṃ gato bhūmigato, sabbarattiṃ sobhaṇo sabbarattisobhaṇo. apāyaṃ gato apāyagato, issarena kataṃ issarakataṃ, sallena viddho sallaviddho, kathinassa dussaṃ kathinadussaṃ

58941.commentary: (DHPa) sabbe pana gandharas'ādayo'pi rasā ukkaṃsato devatānaṃ sudhābhojanaraso'pi saṃsāravaṭṭe pātetvā dukkh'ānubhavanass'eva paccayo. yo pan'esa sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-saṅkhāto ca navalok'uttaradhamma-saṅkhāto ca dhammaraso, ayam'eva sabbarasānaṃ seṭṭho. tena vuttaṃ, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jinātī'ti.

examples.text: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

58942.meaning1: rid of all greed hatred and delusion, with all impurities removed
58942.sanskrit: sarva + rāga + dveṣa + moha + nihita + nirṇīta + kaṣāya

examples.text: so hoti bhikkhu khamo sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti sabba-rāga-dosa-moha-nihita-ninnītakasāvo āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.

58943.meaning1: detached from all desire; with all passion faded

examples.text: sabbarāgavirattassa, taṇhakkhayavimuttino, esanā paṭinissaṭṭhā, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samūhatā.

58944.commentary: (SNPa) tam'eva vā papañcaṃ anuvicca tāya bhāvanāya sabbesaṃ rogānaṃ mūlabandhanā, sabbasmā vā rogānaṃ mūlabandhanā, avijjā-bhavataṇh'ādi-bhedā

examples.text: anuvicca papañcanāmarūpaṃ, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca rogamūlaṃ, sabbarogamūlabandhanā pamutto, anuvidito tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

58945.meaning1: lightest of all; least severe; very least; minimum

58946.meaning1: whole world; entire universe; all the world; every world
58946.commentary: (NIDD2) sabbaloke'ti sabbaapāyaloke sabbamanussaloke sabbadevaloke sabbakhandhaloke sabbadhātuloke sabbaāyatanaloke'ti, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke.

examples.text: sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavatthitā khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati
tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke, ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan'ti.

58947.meaning1: conquering the whole world; mastering the entire universe

examples.text: pabbajam'pi ca anomanikkamo, aggataṃ vajati sabbapāṇinaṃ, tena uttaritaro na vijjati, sabbalokam'abhibhuyya viharatī'ti.

58948.meaning1: benefit of the whole world; welfare of the whole world

examples.text: so n'eva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti, attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva so bhavaṃ gotamo cintento nisinno hoti.
idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti

58949.meaning1: supreme power over the whole world; rulership over the entire universe

examples.text: pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.

58950.meaning1: conqueror of the whole world; master of the entire universe

examples.text: hitvā ratiñ'ca aratiṃ, sītībhūtaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, sabbalok'ābhibhuṃ vīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

58951.meaning1: recognition of disenchantment with the entire world; perception of non-delight in the whole world
58951.commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññā'ti sabbasmiṃ tedhātusannivese loke ukkaṇṭhitassa uppajjanakasaññā.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
idh'ānanda, bhikkhu ye loke upādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā, te pajahanto viharati anupādiyanto. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.

58952.meaning1: recognition of disenchantment with the entire world; perception of non-delight in everything

examples.text: katame nava dhammā uppādetabbā? nava saññā, asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke-anabhiratisaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā. ime nava dhammā uppādetabbā.

58953.meaning1: all activities; all processes; all conditions; all fabrications; all formations

examples.text: sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavatthitā khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati
etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti

58954.meaning1: stilling of all processes; calming of all activities
58954.commentary: (SNPa) sabbasaṅkhārasamathā'ti sabbesaṃ vuttappakārānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ maggañāṇena samathā, upahatatāya phalasamatthatāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (ANa) yasmā pana taṃ āgamma sabbe saṅkhārā samathaṃ gacchanti, tasmā sabbasaṅkhārasamatho'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā, sabbasaṅkhārasamathā, saññānaṃ uparodhanā, evaṃ dukkhakkhayo hoti, etaṃ ñatvā yathātathaṃ.
avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.

58955.meaning1: due to the stilling of all processes, etc.; due to calming all activities, etc.

58957.meaning1: observing the impermanence of all formations; watching the instability of all conditions

examples.text: etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.

58958.meaning1: who has overcome all attachment; who has surpassed all snares
58958.commentary: (THa) sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ tādisaṃ sabbe'pi rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-saṅge atikkamitvā ṭhitattā sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ

examples.text: yo iddhiyā sarabhuṃ aṭṭhapesi, so gavampati asito anejo, taṃ sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ mahāmuniṃ, devā namassanti bhavassa pāragun'ti.

58959.meaning1: with the whole collection of sayings
58959.commentary: (DNa) sabbasaṅgāhapadakatan'ti sabbasaṅgahapadehi kataṃ, sabbasaṅgāhikaṃ kataṃ na hotī'ti attho. sabbasaṅgāhapadagatan'ti'pi pāṭho, na sabbasaṅgāhapadesu gataṃ, na ekasaṅgahajātan'ti attho.

examples.text: satthā ca no loke udapādi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito, aviññāpit'atthā c'amha saddhamme, na ca no kevalaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
evaṃ yāva sabbasatā cattāri cattāri katvā sabbacatukkaṃ nāma assa dāpesi.
diṭṭhā vā y'eva addiṭṭhā, ye ca dūre vasanti avidūre, bhūtā vā sambhavesī vā, sabbasattā bhavantu sukhit'attā.
kathañ'ca bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati? seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti

58962.commentary: (DNa) sabbasantharin'ti yathā sabbaṃ santhataṃ hoti, evaṃ santhariṃ.

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasantharitaṃ satthataṃ āvasath'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

ekam'antaṃ ṭhitā kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, sabbasantharisanthataṃ, bhante, āvasath'āgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telapadīpo āropito, yassa'dāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī'ti.

58964.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sabbasanthari
58964.meaning1: covered completely; spread all over; completely decked out
58964.commentary: (MNa) sabbasanthariṃ santh'āgāraṃ santharitvā'ti yathā sabbam'eva santhataṃ hoti, evaṃ taṃ santharāpetvā.

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santh'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

58965.commentary: (THa) yasmā sīlaṃ sevitaṃ paricitaṃ rakkhitaṃ manussasampatti, dibbasampatti, nibbānasampattī'ti etaṃ sabbasampattiṃ taṃsamaṅgino sattassa upanāmeti āvahati.

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? aparihānadhammo hoti, na parihāyati saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya, na parihāyati sabbasampattiyā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.
sīlam'ev'idha sikkhetha, asmiṃ loke susikkhitaṃ, sīlaṃ hi sabbasampattiṃ, upanāmeti sevitaṃ.

58966.meaning1: all the crops; the entire harvest

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, satikaraṇīyam'eva ahosi, ete dhammā'ti.

58967.meaning1: all the crops; the entire harvest; all kinds of crops

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti.

58968.meaning1: all bonds; all ties; all attachment

examples.text: āguṃ na karoti kiñci loke, sabbasaṃyoge visajja bandhanāni, sabbattha na sajjatī vimutto, nāgo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
jaheyya sabbasaṃyogaṃ, kareyya saraṇ'attano, careyy'ādittasīso'va, patthayaṃ accutaṃ padan'ti.

58969.meaning1: all bonds; all ties; all fetters
58969.commentary: (THa) sabbasaṃyojan'ātītan'ti sabbāni dasa'pi saṃyojanāni yath'ārahaṃ catūhi maggehi saha vāsanāya atikkantaṃ.

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.
sabbasaṃyojanaṃ chetvā, yo ve na paritassati, saṅg'ātigaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

58970.meaning1: wearing away all bonds; destruction of all fetters
58970.commentary: (ITIa) sabbasaṃyojanakkhayan'ti kāmarāgasaṃyojan'ādīnaṃ sabbesaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ khepanato sabbasaṃyojanakkhaya-saṅkhātassa ariyamaggassa pariyosānabhūtaṃ arahattaṃ, tassa ārammaṇabhūtaṃ nibbānam'eva vā.

examples.text: kalyāṇamitto yo bhikkhu, sappatisso sagāravo, karaṃ mittānaṃ vacanaṃ, sampajāno patissato, pāpuṇe anupubbena, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayan'ti.

58971.meaning1: who has overcome all bonds; who has transcended all ties; who has surmounted all fetters
58971.commentary: (SNPa) catūhi'pi maggehi dasannaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ atītattā sabbasaṃyojan'ātigo, catutthen'eva vā uddhambhāgiya-sabbasaṃyojan'ātigo

examples.text: evaṃ virattaṃ khem'attaṃ, sabbasaṃyojan'ātigaṃ, anvesaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu, mārasenā'pi n'ājjhagā'ti.

58972.meaning1: who has passed beyond all bonds; who has escaped all ties
58972.commentary: (THa) sabbasaṃyojan'ātītan'ti sabbāni dasa'pi saṃyojanāni yath'ārahaṃ catūhi maggehi saha vāsanāya atikkantaṃ.

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.

atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, mā h'evaṃ kho uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhi, sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso lahukaṃ suttaguḷaṃ sabbasāramaye aggaḷaphalake pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso taṃ lahukaṃ suttaguḷaṃ sabbasāramaye aggaḷaphalake labhetha otāran'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

imehi kho, gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsiṃ anukampan'ti, suvinītaṃ vinenti, suggahitaṃ gāhāpenti, sabbasippassutaṃ samakkhāyino bhavanti, mitt'āmaccesu paṭiyādenti, disāsu parittāṇaṃ karonti.

58979.commentary: (MNa) sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathenā'ti, setā sudaṃ assā yuttā honti set'ālaṅ'kārā. seto ratho set'ālaṅ'kāro setaparivāro, setā rasmiyo, setā patodalaṭṭhi, setaṃ chattaṃ, setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ, setāni vatthāni, setā upāhanā, setāya sudaṃ vālabījaniyā bījiyatī'ti (saṃ. ni. 5.4) evaṃ vuttena sakalasetena catūhi vaḷavāhi yuttarathena.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāti divādivassa. addasā kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo pilotikaṃ paribbājakaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ.

58980.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
58980.meaning1: in every way; entirely; completely; altogether

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, vītagedhassa brāhmaṇa, āsavā'ssa na vijjanti, yehi maccuvasaṃ vaje'ti.

58981.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
58981.meaning1: all around; everywhere; from all sides

examples.text: madhurañ'ca pavanti sabbaso, kusumarajena samuṭṭhitā dumā, paṭhamavasanto sukho utu, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.
atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ mahāviyūhassa kūṭ'āgārassa dvāre sabbasovaṇṇamayaṃ tālavanaṃ māpeyyaṃ, yattha divāvihāraṃ nisīdissāmī'ti.

58984.meaning1: all one's belongings; everything one owns
58984.commentary: (ANa) sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā'ti sabbena'pi sakena dhanena c'eva attanā ca saddhiṃ yo parājayo, so appamattako'va kalī'ti attho.

examples.text: appamatto ayaṃ kali, yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo, sabbassa-api sahā'pi attanā, ayam'eva mahantataro kali.

58986.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

58987.meaning1: rid of all crookedness and flaws, with all impurities removed
58987.sanskrit: sarva + vaṅka + doṣa + nihita + nirṇīta + kaṣāya

examples.text: so hoti āraññako nāgo khamo sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ sarapattappahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-vaṃsa-saṅkha-ḍiṇḍima-ninnādasaddānaṃ sabbavaṅkadosanihita-ninnītakasāvo rāj'āraho rājabhoggo rañño aṅgan't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

58988.meaning1: all faults; all errors; all mistakes

examples.text: evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ. vajjabhīruno, bhikkhave, vajjabhayadassāvino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ parimuccissati sabbavajjehī'ti.

58990.meaning1: (Jain) purified by all restraints; cleansed by all curbs; (or) shaken off all restraints
58990.notes: play on words with multiple possible meanings

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo.

58991.meaning1: (Jain) pervaded with all restraints; (or) broken all restraints
58991.notes: play on words with multiple possible meanings

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo.

58992.meaning1: (Jain) bound by all restraints; (or) possessed of all restraints
58992.notes: play on words with multiple possible meanings

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo.

58993.meaning1: (Jain) restrained by all restraints; curbed by all curbs; checked by all checks; (comm) (or) rejected all water
58993.commentary: (MNa) sabbavārivārito'ti vāritasabbaudako, paṭikkhittasabbasīt'odako'ti attho. so hi sīt'odake sattasaññī hoti, tasmā na taṃ valañjeti. atha vā sabbavārivārito'ti sabbena pāpavāraṇena vāritapāpo.
58993.notes: play on words with multiple possible meanings

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo.
sabb'ābhibhū sabbavidū'ham'asmi, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, sabbañ'jaho taṇhakkhaye vimutto, sayaṃ abhiññāya kam'uddiseyyaṃ.
sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.

58996.meaning1: all that is felt; all that is experienced; all feeling
58996.commentary: (ITIa) sabbavedayitānī'ti sukh'ādayo sabbā abyākatavedanā, kusal'ākusalavedanā pana pubbe'y'eva pahīnā'ti.

examples.text: tassa idh'eva, bhikkhave, sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sīti bhavissanti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anupādisesā nibbānadhātu. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve nibbānadhātuyo'ti.
kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī'ti pajānāti.
te tadah'uposathe sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti, ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, sabbaverāni nikkhipitvā evaṃ vadehi, n'āhaṃ kvacani kassaci kiñcanat'asmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani katthaci kiñcanat'atthī'ti.
te khemappattā sukhino, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, sabbaverabhay'ātītā, sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.

58999.commentary: (VINa) sabbaṃ hatthan'ti sakalahatthaṃ. (VINt) sabbaṃ hatthan'ti ettha hatthasaddo tadekadesesu aṅgulīsu daṭṭhabbo, hatthamuddā'ti-ādīsu viya, samudāye pavattavohārassa avayave'pi vattanato ek'aṅgulim'pi mukhe pakkhipituṃ na vaṭṭati.

examples.text: na bhuñjamāno sabbahatthaṃ mukhe pakkhipissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
